edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
Owned constructor writes msg.sender into owner.
onlyOwner modifier requires(msg.sender == owner) gating transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates the transferAnyERC20Token rescue call.
acceptOwnership requires(msg.sender == newOwner) to authorize the ownership change.
msg.sender indexes balances as the debited source account in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping when writing an approval in approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender key of allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender is written to storage and then forwarded as an argument of the external receiveApproval call.
transferOwnership stores the caller-supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate and promote it.
acceptOwnership assigns owner = newOwner and clears newOwner.
Token constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Token constructor sets the name state variable.
Token constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Token constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
Token constructor credits the whole supply into balances of the hard-coded address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in the subtraction.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping entry for tokenOwner.
transfer reads and writes balances entries for msg.sender and to.
transferFrom reads and writes balances entries for from and to.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom debits the allowed mapping entry for from and msg.sender.
allowance reads the allowed mapping entry for tokenOwner and spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before calling the spender.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the rescued tokens to the owner address.
transfer performs an internal call to safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer performs an internal call to safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom performs internal calls to safeSub for both balance and allowance.
transferFrom performs an internal call to safeAdd on the recipient balance.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction that can underflow silently.
approveAndCall executes the external receiveApproval call after updating state.
The called spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall before the call returns.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
The arbitrary token contract can re-enter the owner-gated rescue function or other state-changing functions.
